unresolved: The wuda-mingyao listing differs across volumes (Zhao Nong: Guan, Ru, Jun, Ge, Ding; Xia Yanjing 2009: Ru, Guan, Jun, Ge, Ding; 2016: Ru, Guan, Ding, Jun, Ge) and Tian Zibing explicitly calls the list biased, citing Cizhou and Jizhou; this batch records the disagreement without adjudicating
Song-dynasty 'kiln system' (yaoxi) is never defined; the only quantitative statement is a geographic distribution (17 provinces, 130-plus counties), which is not a count of kiln systems
Ru kiln site: Baofeng Qingliangsi versus Linru; start date: early Northern Song versus Huizong reign; decoration: carved/incised versus plain — three disagreements left side by side

Jun kiln classification: Gao Feng treats it as 'kiln-transmutation flower ware', Tian Zibing and Zhao Nong place it in the celadon system; the official-versus-folk Jun distinction further complicates the label

Ding kiln inscription lists differ across four volumes (Guan/Xinguan; Fenghua/Juxiu/Cifu/Guan; Shangshiju/Shangyaoju/Wufuwang/Cifu; Guan only); the terminal date has three versions (to Northern Song, lost in Yuan, continuing through Jin)

Ge kiln has no excavated site; the Longquan attribution and the Xiuneisi attribution coexist; the Zhang Sheng-yi / Zhang Sheng-er legend is treated as fact by Zhao Nong and as legend by Tian Zibing and Xia Yanjing
Chai kiln may not exist; Dong kiln rests entirely on one Gegu Yaolun passage plus two glosses by Tian Zibing, with no site and no object
Northern Song official kiln has no located site; the 'Daguan-Zhenghe' and 'Zhenghe' reign-date phrasings coexist; the two Southern Song sites are not dated to specific years in the six volumes

Kiln organization evidence is kiln-side only: Yuqichang, Fuliang ciju, Ciyaoguan and Jingdezhen are D-dimension KUs, not mounted; the D-dimension premodern official-handicraft theme that should hold them does not exist yet

Scale data are nearly absent: only Chifeng (about two square li), Jingdezhen (egg-shaped wood kiln about 28 m, 200,000-plus workers) provide figures; output, workshop area, workforce and yield rate are missing for every other kiln

Artisan material is one or two sentences each (He Chaozong, Shu Weng, Shu Jiao, Huang Maijiu); Shu Weng and Shu Jiao come from consecutive sentences of the same passage and cannot corroborate each other
notes: 本批新建 1 个 Topic（B.6.3 窑系、名窑与窑业组织），挂载 25 个 KU，不新增 Theme。结构设计的四项判断：其一，B.6.3 承担 Theme 的第三层“命名系统”，与 B.6.1 的材料判据、B.6.2 的窑业条件并列；内部按“合称—窑系—单窑”三级名单的可靠性递减、“地望／制度／姓氏传说／文献品第”四种命名依据与“有址有物／有址有争议／无址有物／无址无物”四级证据强度组织，不按朝代罗列窑口。其二，角色分配沿用 B.5.2 与 B.6.1 的惯例：具体名目（五大名窑、宋代窑系、官窑、哥窑、柴窑）用 term_anchor，窑址统一用 geographical_context，瓷艺人用 key_person，定窑孩儿枕用 representative_work。其三，御器厂、浮梁瓷局、瓷窑官与景德镇四条 primary_dimension 为 D，apply_topic_memberships.py 强制 primary_dimension 与 primary_theme 首段一致，本批不为它们制造跨维度挂载，改在景德镇窑、赤峰缸瓦窑屯辽窑与宋代官窑窑址三条内引用其窑侧内容，并在 Topic 边界、topics README 与 dimension-candidates 中登记为跨维度接口。其四，石湾窑经复核为“明代两个生产精陶的名窑之一”，属陶器线，按 B.6 边界留 B.5.5，挂载数由 26 降为 25。v1.13 归档取 git HEAD 字节（20211 字节），哈希 sha256:4d23b12bd8ee1782a7d214a0e82861a6bcf67fcf418a0de139ced1dc696582e9 与 h22 apply-plan 记录逐字节一致。relation 总数由 6572 增至 6622（25 Theme + 25 Topic），member_of 由 574 增至 624；隔离单元由 1377 降至 1367（25 个 KU 中 10 个原本已通过 claim 关系入图）。未新增 KU、claim、candidate 或来源字节，未改写 03基础书籍-md文档/ 与 02-sources/，未执行 commit 或 push。
